title: test(e2e-live): B3 cascading-options live e2e — client re-filter + server rejection (#2559)
body:
## Context

The **objectui** half of the remaining B3 work (item 3 of #2559) — a live-backend e2e for cascading / dependent `select` options and their server-side enforcement. Companion to the framework fixture (objectstack-ai/framework#3006) and the no-backend docs e2e from #2547.

## What's added

`e2e/live/cascading-options.spec.ts` — drives the framework showcase `showcase_cascade` object against the **real** console + backend and asserts the dual-side B3 contract:

1. **CLIENT (UX)** — opening the create form and driving the parent `country` re-filters the child `province`'s **offered** option set (China → Zhejiang/Guangdong; US → California/Texas), and a now-invalid child value **clears** (cascade-clear).
2. **SERVER (boundary)** — `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_cascade` **rejects** an out-of-set option value (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED` / `invalid_option`) and **accepts** the in-set one. Client hiding is UX; the server is the boundary.

Mirrors `e2e/live/field-conditional-rules.spec.ts` and reuses the `selectOption` helper.

## CI safety

Lives under `e2e/live/`, which the default Playwright config excludes (`testIgnore: ['**/live/**']`), so it never runs in the default/CI job — it is opt-in via `pnpm test:e2e:live` with the stack up (auth handled by `e2e/live/global-setup.ts`), exactly like every other live spec.

## Verification

- `eslint` clean; `playwright test --list` discovers both tests (compiles cleanly under the live config).
- The server-rejection path was verified live against a fresh framework backend: `{country:'us',province:'zj'}` → **400** `invalid_option`; `{country:'cn',province:'zj'}` → **201**.

## Related

- Item 3 of #2559 (part of #1583). Framework fixture + server enforcement: objectstack-ai/framework#3006 / framework#2915.
- No-backend docs e2e: #2547 (`e2e/cascading-options.spec.ts`).
